description:
FOUND s455f (Fable review of s458al #840). The STATIC table is right (pure `use warnings` = 80 keys, mirrored exactly); the +1 in perl comes from the real experimental.pm calling warnings::register_* as it loads, which PCL's warnings stub does not implement -- so a category registered at RUNTIME never appears in %Offsets and warnings::enabled('<pkg>') for a registering package answers from absence. FIX SHAPE: implement register_categories/register in the warnings extension (or the runtime stub) appending 2 bits per new category past $BYTES*8, mirroring perl's allocation; probe = key-count parity after use experimental + warnings::warnif on a registered category. Small; rides with #873/#874 or any warnings-family slot.

DONE s459an (agent AN, round 16).  TWO halves, and the second is the one the probe was really measuring.  (1) register_categories ALLOCATES (lib/warnings.pm): the next offset is derived from the table as max+2, which IS perl's $LAST_BIT at every step and therefore cannot drift from the mirrored table the way a second constant would; a known name (including 'all', offset 0) is untouched.  Probed vs perl 5.40.3: 160 then 162.  $warnings::BYTES was a stale 12 and is now perl's 20 -- NOT trivia, since perl's invariant is $LAST_BIT == $BYTES*8 and 12 would put the first runtime category on top of deprecated::goto_construct.  (2) the missing key was 'version', registered by the REAL version.pm as it loads (`warnings::register_categories(qw/version/)`), which experimental.pm pulls in -- so PCL's lib/version.pm now declares it the same way.  Key-count parity with perl: base 80, +1 [version=160], identical.  NOT implemented, deliberately: `use warnings::register` (it registers the CALLING package; PCL skips lexical pragmas at parse time, so there is no caller to read -- and perl's own users call register_categories explicitly as well).  $warnings::LAST_BIT itself stays unmirrored, in the family the runtime comment already lists (%Bits/%DeadBits).  Guard Pl/t/feature-pragma-01.t +1 row, compared against a fresh perl on the same file; artifact cl/pcl-warnings.lisp regenerated; sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18340 (+0).
subject: warnings::register_categories / warnings::register do not ADD to %warnings::Offsets at runtime -- a loading module's registered category is missing (count 80 vs perl's 81 after `use experimental 'try'`)
